subject: Linguistics
title: Undeciphered Scripts
description: A quick win: understand Undeciphered Scripts.

hook.text: The Indus Valley script has over 400 symbols—found on thousands of artifacts. No one can read them.

buildup.text: Several ancient scripts remain undeciphered because we lack bilingual texts or knowledge of the language.

discovery.text: Linear A (Minoan), Proto-Elamite, and Rongorongo (Easter Island) are among the famous unsolved scripts.

twist.text: Without knowing the language behind the script, decipherment may be impossible—the key is the language.

climax.text: Modern AI is being applied to these scripts—but so far, no breakthrough has occurred.

punchline.text: Some ancient voices still refuse to be heard.

quiz.question: Why are some scripts still undeciphered?
options: We lack bilingual texts or knowledge of the language
